intent: Make the arch_perf_probes lib tests independent of the host's real load average so the pre-push ci-mirror gate is not red whenever a game is running.
changes: collect_basics reads the 1-minute load from ${LOADAVG_FILE:-/proc/loadavg}; behaviour on the host is unchanged
The harness exports LOADAVG_FILE into TEST_TMPDIR and arch_reset writes a quiet fixture (0.10)
The load test now asserts the (16/16) finding from a 16.50 fixture instead of SKIPping when the host is idle; a missing file case asserts no finding

verification.evidence: arch_perf_probes (basics/governor): 17 passed, 0 failed (was 16 with one SKIP, and 1 failed at host load 22/16)
All fixes lib test files passed.

risks: None on the host: the default path is the real /proc/loadavg
rollback: git revert the commit; the tests return to reading the real load and go red under host load
